name: Canaria-Phase2A-precision-composition-v1

quantization.type: post-training symmetric per-matrix signed uniform dequantized weights
quantization.scale_storage: FP16, one scale per Linear weight matrix for bits<32
quantization.bias: replacement Linear layers have no bias

selection.selected_endpoint: minimum parameter budget passing both criteria separately for component-wise and composed conditions at each precision

primary_hypothesis: At 4-bit precision, composed replacement has lower minimum passing coded size than component-wise replacement.
primary_decision: PASS iff >=7/8 seeds have coded_bits_comp < coded_bits_sep and seed-bootstrap 95% CI upper bound of mean log2(coded_bits_comp/coded_bits_sep) < 0; FAIL if CI lower bound >=0 or <=1/8 wins; otherwise UNCERTAIN.
secondary: selected test accuracy difference after validation-only selection
quantization-induced change in NMSE and pass frontier
scope: Exploratory new-phase experiment; does not modify frozen v0.2.0 claims.
